title: The G-Nome Project
start: Talk to Queen of Snow in the northern section of the Grand Exchange.

recommended.t: 24 free backpack spaces for the required items, to save banking trips
Ability to teleport to the Varrock and Port Sarim lodestone, and either having the Al Kharid lodestone unlocked or a charged amulet of glory
Teleport to Grand Exchange, e.g. ring of Wealth or Varrock Teleport with easy Varrock achievements completed

rewards.t: Full access (upgrading) of the energy rift, power generator and unlocking modified soul obelisk.
Energy rift will spawn anomalies nearby, sealing them rewards experience
Power generator will have a side event of smoking control panel, pressing it rewards experience
Modified soul obelisk will give more experience if the gauge is kept at centre of the meter

steps.t: Talk to the Queen of Snow north of the Grand Exchange. [Chat: Accept]
Talk to Aubury, Doc, and Orla.
Talk to the Queen of Snow.
Talk to Thurgo in his hut south of Port Sarim. (1 Redberry pie) [Chat: 1 Talk about Santa.]
Enter the Grotworm Lair in the White Knight Camp slightly north of the Port Sarim lodestone.
On the platform, investigate the damaged sleigh.
Gather Rudolph's ashes.
Talk to Santa.
Talk to Doc, just north of Santa. (100 Pale energy)
Tinker with the power generator until the damage reaches 0%.
Keep on tinkering with the generator until the control panel starts to smoke, then fix the control panel.

sub.t: You can configure the generator to gain scm | smithing Smithing or scm | crafting Crafting xp.

steps.t: Try the machine on yourself, and then try it on the gnome.
Talk to Aubury, to the west of Santa. (10 Rune/Pure Essence) [Chat: 1 Anomalies are bad. › 2 I can seal anomalies while channeling the rift. › 1 I will need to seal 15 anomalies.]
Channel the energy rift until it is charged 100%.
Keep channeling the rift, sealing 15 anomalies as they spawn around the rift.

sub.t: You can configure the rift to gain scm | runecrafting Runecrafting or Summoning Summoning xp.

steps.t: Talk to Orla, to the east of Santa. (12 Raw lobster)
Talk to the Menaphite Smuggler standing next to the soul obelisk south of the desert strykewyrm area. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Talk to Orla.
Siphon the soul obelisk until you absorb the soul 100%.
Use the arrows on screen, or the arrow keys (←→) to keep the gauge balanced.

sub.t: You can configure the obelisk to gain scm | divination Divination or scm | prayer Prayer xp.

steps.t: Talk to Orla. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Talk to Santa.
Talk to Santa again to teleport to the Phoenix Lair. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Talk to Santa.
Back at the Grand Exchange, talk to Santa again.
Talk to Santa.
Event complete!

get_inside.text: Varrock
Methods for free-to-play players
Use a clan vexillum to teleport directly to the Grand Exchange.
Teleport to Varrock (either via the Varrock Teleport spell or the Varrock lodestone) and walk the rest of the way.
Teleport to the air altar using an air altar teleport, then walk north-east.
Use a canoe to travel to the Barbarian Village station, then walk north-east.
Teleport using the skull sceptre to outside the Stronghold of Security, then cross the bridge to the east and walk north-east.
Teleport to Edgeville using the Edgeville lodestone and run east.
Teleport to the yew trees in Varrock Palace using the oaken, willow, maple, or Nature's sentinel outfit and run west.
Methods for members
Use a ring of Wealth, ring of Fortune, Luck of the Dwarves, or a Hazelmere's signet ring, to teleport directly to the Grand Exchange.
Complete the easy Varrock achievements and set your Varrock Teleport destination to the entrance of the Grand Exchange.
Teleport to Edgeville via a method of choice (such as fairy ring code DKR), then use the tunnel shortcut (requiring level 21 Agility) to crawl under the Grand Exchange's north-western wall.
Use the Keldagrim minecart system (requiring partial completion of The Giant Dwarf) to travel from Keldagrim to the trapdoor in the north-west corner of the Grand Exchange.
Use the spirit tree system (requiring completion of Tree Gnome Village quest) to travel from any spirit tree to the one in the north-east corner of the Grand Exchange.
Use a Grand Exchange Teleport scroll to teleport to the Grand Exchange.
Talk to the Grand Exchange clerks in the Tower of Voices and Max Guild in Prifddinas, or Merchant District in Menaphos, who offer free teleports to the Grand Exchange in Varrock.
Use radiant alchemist's amulet or luminous alchemist's amulet (charged) to teleport to the entrance of the Grand Exchange daily.
Tower of Voices
Teleport to Prifddinas via the Prifddinas lodestone, this brings you directly to the Tower of Voices.
Teleport to outside the clan portal at the Tower of Voices using a Clan vexillum.
Max Guild
Teleport directly there using the Max guild Teleport.
Teleport to the Max Guild garden using a grace of the elves, then go south and enter the Max Guild.
Teleport to the Cadarn Clan district using a crystal teleport seed or attuned crystal teleport seed, this puts you north-west of the Max Guild and west of the entrance to the Max Guild garden.
Merchant District
Teleport to Menaphos via the Menaphos lodestone, then go north-east.
Teleport to the Menaphos Merchant district using a Merchant district teleport tablet, then go south-east.
